rows.label: Skill on each combat style
rows.consequence: A character with that style adds no style skill to a Strike, a technique's hit roll or their defense roll.
rows.missing_detail: Bare Style 1 combat style(s) have no skill: their rolls add none.

rows.label: Hit stat on each combat style
rows.consequence: A Strike by a character with that style hits with the weapon's stat.
rows.missing_detail: Bare Style 1 combat style(s) have no hit stat: a Strike uses the weapon's.

rows.label: Weapon kinds on each combat style
rows.consequence: Every attack by a character with that style lapses the style, so its skill never counts on a Strike or a technique's hit roll.
rows.missing_detail: Bare Style 1 combat style(s) list no weapon kind: their skill never counts on an attack.

rows.label: Each Tradition teaches a combat style
rows.consequence: A student of that Tradition has no combat style to learn.
rows.missing_detail: Lonely Tradition 1 active Tradition(s) teach no combat style.
